messages:
elaine: Draft release note + internal announce for tomorrow's micro-release. Target change window Mon 10:00-11:00 PT. Deploybot will stage at 09:50. Need quick signoff on RN copy, pin matrix, and rollback owner/criteria.

sanjay: Dropping my short RN copy below, kept it terse for internal blast. Add customer-impact if you want.

elaine: ```
What: Minor inference stability fixes and timeout reductions
Why: Reduce intermittent timeouts during high-concurrency requests
Impact: No breaking changes; rollout by region; expected reduction in 95th latency and timeout rate
When: Mon 10:00-11:00 PT (staging at 09:50)
Rollout: Canary -> regional rollout -> full for hosted tier
Rollback: revert to v1.4.2 if errors regress beyond thresholds
```

marta: LGTM on copy. Suggest tweak the Impact line to be more specific (numbers).

amanda: small nit: change 'reduction in 95th latency' -> 'reduce p95 latency by ~10-15% on avg'

elaine: updated. Pin matrix: eng-oncall, eng-sre (Devon), product (Sanjay), CS (Amanda). Legal only if data retention/response shape changes (none).

devon: I'll be on-call for the window. Rollback criteria proposal:
- >=5% absolute increase in /v1/generate error rate sustained for 10m OR
- p95 latency > baseline + 150ms sustained for 15m
If triggered, I'll initiate rollback and notify on-call rotation.

sanjay: Agree with criteria. Also add automated sentinel: if deploy-bot reports >3 failed health checks during canary, auto-pause rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy staged at 09:50 -> job #87431 queued. preflight checks running.

devon: Rollback command (manual):
```
deployctl rollback --service=inference --to-tag=prod-v1.4.2 --reason="p95 regression"
```
I'll run that and then ping #eng-sre and #eng-releases.

marta: Suggest we include a short QA checklist in the RN for synchronous checks during the canary (sample prompts + expected tokens).

elaine: Good call — adding a 3-item QA checklist in RN. Also adding the notification snippet for the internal announce.

elaine: Internal announce (short):
"Tomorrow 10:00 PT: Minor inference rollout to improve timeout handling and reduce p95 latency. No API contract changes. If you see increased errors please @devon and escalate to #eng-sre."

amanda: That reads clean. I'll prep CS notes and a triage doc.

deploy-bot: reminder 09:45 -> preflight checks passed. canary gate ready.

sanjay: I'll do a final pass on RN copy at 08:30 and merge. Elaine, can you pin the internal announce to the release thread once merged?

elaine: Yep — merging at 08:30 and will pin. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: job #87431 -> status: staged (waiting 09:50).
